Health Functional FoodNiacin 15mgMilk thistle 130mgVitamin B2 1.4mgVitamin B6 1.5mgSelenium 55μgZinc 8.5mgFolate 400μgPantothenic acid 5mgOnce a day

리버케어 밀크씨슬Niacin · Milk thistle · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by (주)비오팜 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 130mg of Milk thistle, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 55μg of Selenium, 8.5mg of Zinc, 400μg of Folate, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 15mg Niacin, 130mg Milk thistle, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 55μg Selenium, 8.5mg Zinc, 400μg Folate, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)비오팜

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Milk thistle
    • May help with liver health
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 900mg), 80~150%
Milk thistle labelled (130mg / 900mg), 80~120%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 900mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 900mg), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (55μg / 900mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 900mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (400μg / 900mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (5mg / 900mg), 80~180%
Appearance 이미, 이취가 없고 고유의 향미가 있는 연한황색의 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage ① 직사광선 및 고온 다습한 곳을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. ② 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Milk thistle · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

리버케어 밀크씨슬Niacin · Milk thistle · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 7.5mg of Niacin, 130mg of Milk thistle, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 27.5μg of Selenium, 4.3mg of Zinc, 200μg of Folate, 2.5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 7.5mg Niacin, 130mg Milk thistle, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 27.5μg Selenium, 4.3mg Zinc, 200μg Folate, 2.5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Milk thistle
    • May help with liver health
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (7.5mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Milk thistle labelled (130mg / 500mg), 80~120%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (27.5μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (4.3mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (200μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (2.5mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없으며 점박이가 있는 진한 노랑색의 장방형 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선을 피하고 서늘한 곳에 보관(실온)

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Milk thistle · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

    • 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
